prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Which Way Is North?; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Kit and Zoe in an open school field away from metal structures and electrical equipment. Gray gate at the local magnetic-east side of the demonstration; green tree toward local magnetic north. No geographically fixed location is claimed. Round transparent compass held flat with red north-seeking half and white south-seeking half.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One freely pivoting red/white compass needle; White compass ring marked N E S W; Gray gate to local magnetic east; Green tree to local magnetic north
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: No needle close-up before stable holding.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Kit turns in open field with tree and gate fixed behind; Zoe holds compass flat ready to show him.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions. Reference-sheet override: any lettering requested by the opening page brief belongs only in that finished page. Keep this production reference board entirely unlabelled; no letters, numbers or pseudo-writing.
Finish requirement: all fills are perfectly smooth, clean, flat vector-like color. Absolutely no paper grain, stipple, speckles, mottled paint, fuzzy edges or surface noise anywhere, including backgrounds. Clear crisp outlines and only a few flat cel-shadow shapes. Do not imitate texture from any supporting reference.

visualReview.note: Native and installed WebP directly viewed: consistent Kit/Zoe, one red-white pivoted compass needle, unlettered dial reference, fixed green tree and gray gate school-field key.
visualReview.limits: Independent sequence and reader review follow separately.
